```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Native communities have been devastated by an epidemic of disappearances and killings for decades, too often without resolution, justice, or accountability.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden is taking action to address the missing and murdered Indigenous persons crisis.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Departments of Justice and the Interior are working together to accelerate investigations into missing and murdered Indigenous persons.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Department of the Interior is creating a unit to work on the issue of missing and murdered Indigenous persons.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The FBI is hiring personnel to focus on cases of missing and murdered Indigenous persons.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats reauthorized the Violence Against Women Act after Trump failed to do so, and included new protections and programs to support Tribal survivors through the expansion of special criminal jurisdiction of Tribal courts.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration awarded $68 million in grants to support Native communities to provide services and promote justice for survivors of domestic violence, sexual assault, dating violence, stalking, and trafficking.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration is implementing the Not Invisible Act Commission recommendations to address violent crime and the high rates of people reported missing in Native communities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration relaunched the North American Trilateral Working Group on Violence Against Indigenous Women and Girls.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration issued final fee-to-trust land acquisitions rules.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration issued changes to Native American Graves Protection and Repatriation Act regulations.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
